newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MARADONA ADMITS AVOIDING MATCHES AFTER HOME TESTS-PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARADONA ADMITS AVOIDING MATCHES AFTER HOME TESTS-PAPER.

text.p: Former Argentina captain Diego Maradona has admitted avoiding matches when his own private dope tests were positive, the Italian newspaper La Repubblica reported on Monday.

Maradona, who has received treatment for cocaine addiction, also told the the newspaper in an interview in Buenos Aires that he hoped to play again for Argentine club Boca Juniors before the end of the year.

The 36-year-old, whose manager Guillermo Coppola is in jail on cocaine-dealing charges, denied recent allegations that his urine sample was switched with that of another player after a routine post-match test on August 11.

The sample from the other player, from Boca's opponents Estudiantes, was found to be positive. Maradona, whose test was negative, has not played for the club since then and went to a Swiss clinic for treatment shortly after the match.

"It's a load of nonsense. Because for years I have done my own anti-doping controls on my own, during the week before the match. And if I tested positive in my tests, I did not play on Sunday," Maradona said of the allegations.
"And I played that time didn't I? And so..."
Once the most expensive player in the world, Maradona's career has been dogged by scandal.
In 1994 he was banned from international matches for 15 months after failing a dope test at the World Cup finals in the United States.
In 1991 he was banned for 15 months for testing positive for cocaine while playing for Napoli in Italy.
Maradona, in the article headlined "I take drugs, I'm sick but I don't sell cocaine", said political reasons were behind Coppola's arrest and vowed to stand by his friend.
"My life now is to prove his innocence," he said.
"I take drugs, yes. But I swear that I am not a trafficker... If he is a drug trafficker then so am I. But he is not and would not even have had time to do it without me knowing.
"Soccer has always been important to me but now it has moved into the background, inevitably," he added.

Asked whether he would play again, Maradona replied: "Yes, I think so. I will play at least one match with Boca before the end of the year. I will talk to Coppola about it, I'll ask his permission. We will see."
Coppola has been charged with possession of drugs for sale and could face up to 20 years in jail.
